observations.behavior: Adds a 6000-character bound for note-only edits and a helper to truncate Slack-compatible markdown.
observations.posthog_connection: This bound prevents note-only edits from exceeding Slack's message length limits, which could otherwise cause delivery failures or truncation. The comment explains the rationale: Slack shows at most SLACK_SECTION_TEXT_MAX_LEN characters after conversion, so anything past this headroom is never rendered.

observations.behavior: Adds a helper to truncate report titles to 150 characters and a helper to construct a Slack action block with a button.
observations.code_quote: return title if len(title) <= 150 else title[:147].rstrip() + "..."
observations.posthog_connection: This helper ensures report titles are truncated to a reasonable length for Slack compatibility. The button block allows users to click a link to view the report in PostHog, improving usability.

observations.behavior: Adds a new Slack message builder for note-only edits, which posts the note instead of the full report message.
observations.posthog_connection: This helper ensures that note-only edits are delivered as updates rather than duplicate messages. The note is truncated and converted to Slack-compatible markdown, and the report link is included. This prevents duplicate messages and improves the user experience.
